R2VA.risk: Veda Predictor main training context uses 8-step; R2VA with 4-step Turbo requires actual quality/speed verification.

runtime.veda: separate predictor for each task; not a LoRA
runtime.notes: Veda predictor has principal training conditions around 8-step Turbo; 4-step R2VA is a separate compatibility experiment, not certified optimal.

notes: Do not mix Weapon preset A4 by default with other strong motion LoRAs.
Prompt scenario must match the selected preset; weights alone do not rewrite a fight scene.
These values are starting configurations, not results from an RTX 4090 run.
BASE is experimental control independent of the nine A0–A8 presets; it disables only JOKER141 motion LoRAs, not Turbo or Veda.
Preset switch in ComfyUI does NOT automatically alter the text prompt. Use sync_fight_workflow.py to export an aligned JSON, or edit the prompt to match the recipe.
Trigger words are model-card conventions, not mandatory official H3 prompt fields; omit inactive LoRA triggers.
source_evidence: A0–A8 are local experimental recipes; only source-specific numbers are individually attributed in model card. Composite weights not automatically author-validated.

baseline.name: 五项专项 LoRA 全零的无专项 LoRA 基线
baseline.workflow_switch_method: manual_override=true and all five manual weights=0; or use scripts/sync_fight_workflow.py --preset BASE

Combat V2.notes: Default no trigger for anatomy; prefer action completed before dialogue.

Weapon Combat V1.notes: Standalone recommended; combination with strong motion LoRAs may clash.

GunFu.notes: Cinematic action depiction only; first-pass 0.9 baseline.

Fight Flow V1.notes: Only emit if Fight Flow > 0. Select by dominant interaction not props.
